decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal is for the erection of a two storey rear extension and a single storey side extension and is considered to complement the existing built form with regard to position, bulk, scale, materials and appearance and would not result in any significant adverse impacts upon the amenity of the existing site, adjoining and neighbouring properties or street scene. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a two storey rear extension and a single storey side extension
